debts.title: Avishek — first-draft intake has no promoted active thesis authority

The archived Prism log reports a conversion/build but actual output bytes were confirmed unavailable and recovery waived; this does not establish current scientific or output authority.

debts.title: Avishek — resolve numerical-only versus laboratory-experiment methodology
debts.description: The first-draft abstract describes accelerated corrosion, pull-out and cyclic laboratory testing, while its objectives and limitations describe a numerical Abaqus study without laboratory experiments. The archived review explicitly marks this contradiction unresolved; neither method is yet confirmed as final scope.
debts.close_when: Obtain researcher/supervisor-approved methodological scope, source-backed validation plan and updated governed thesis version; do not silently rewrite the user draft.
